writingPrompts.title: My Best Friend
writingPrompts.prompt: Write about your best friend. What is their name? What do you like about them? What do you do together?
writingPrompts.sampleResponse: My best friend is Rahul. He is very kind and funny. He has brown eyes and black hair. We like to play games together at school. We eat lunch together. Rahul makes me happy.

organization.excellent: Writing has a clear beginning, middle, and end
organization.good: Ideas are organized and somewhat clear
organization.satisfactory: Some organization but may be confusing
organization.needsWork: Ideas are scattered and hard to follow

grammar.good: Few grammar errors that don't confuse meaning
grammar.satisfactory: Some grammar errors but mostly understandable
grammar.needsWork: Many grammar errors, hard to understand

creativity.excellent: Shows creative thinking and unique ideas

writingPrompts.title: A Day at the Park
writingPrompts.prompt: Write about a day you went to the park. What did you do there? Who went with you? What was your favorite part?
writingPrompts.sampleResponse: I went to the park with my family. We played on the slide and the swing. My little sister laughed a lot. We saw a dog playing. The dog was very friendly. We gave him water to drink. Then we ate ice cream. I loved the park.

vocabulary.excellent: Action words and descriptive words used well

writingPrompts.title: My Dream House
writingPrompts.prompt: Imagine your dream house. What does it look like? How many rooms does it have? What is your favorite room? Why?
writingPrompts.sampleResponse: My dream house is very big and beautiful. It has a red door and blue windows. There are six rooms in my house. My favorite room is my bedroom. My room is very big. I have a big bed and a pink desk. I have many books on my shelf. I love to read in my room. There is also a beautiful garden with flowers.

organization.excellent: Organized with clear description of details
